scene: Inside the lighthouse base, spiraling stairs rise past humming machinery.
picture: Side view inside round stone room. Far left, spiral stairs curve upward. Left of centre, the boy in orange vest and kite stands facing right. Right of centre, a brass machine ticks with glowing blue dials. Far right, a wooden trapdoor lies shut on the stone floor.
shown: Curving metal spiral stairs on the far left ascending upward.
A whirring brass machine with glowing dials right of centre.
A heavy wooden trapdoor with iron ring on the far right.

variants.scene: A warm lantern glows beside clanking pipes inside the round stone tower.
Pipes rattle and dials glow blue in the cool stone lighthouse chamber.
The lighthouse hums with gears while you search around for {quest}.
